Kijuh ki siej, iapher ka jingkhot 64 --- Page 7 --- KA LAMPHRANG Ka mariang ha ka jinginaian bad ka jinghuhrieh jong ka ia ki spah markhlaw byin lah niewtang shuh ka la lum thup halor kine ki lum.
Kine ki lum, ki them ki lyhuh.
ki pyntha madan, ki riat ki ram, etc.
Nalor ba ki itynnad katue katuc, la pynkup ha ki da ki Tusbir ba iphieng kiba phalang ha ki jingiohi ba iai kyila inan ba ka pynthymmai la ki Samoi jong ka.
Ka jingdon kyurei jong ki I.aiphew skit ki spah mar khiaw, ki long kiba ngi dei hok shish han sngey phuhmat.
Ka ri rhina kaba pawnam ha ka jingdon ki jait si.j kiha pher, la ong ha ka don palat ia ka 30 jait.
Ka Jylla Assan ka pawnam ha ka jinpdon siej ka don 18 jait.

Ka Meghalaya, wat la ym pat lah ban ng thinna, hynrei ngim duna ia ka 30 jait ki jait sie bapher Ha ine 1 kitab namar ba nga la shim bun kynthup tang shaphang u siej, kumta ngin ym kiah ia kiwei pat ki mar khlaw.
Napdeng kiba bun ki jait siej kiba ngi don, katto katne na ki, kum u Pantabat, u Rthem, u Tyrlaw, u Tangei, u Sparbah bad wat u Stew ruh, ki long kiba ngi don tang kum ki nongmuna.
Kumta ngi dei ban ri tyngkai ia ki.
Wat napdeng ki jait siey kiba ngi khein shngain be ngi don pahuh, hynrei mynta kim pahuh shuh.
Bun na ki lada ngim sunar bad ialeh ban ri tyngkai, kin sa nang jah rngai suhi.
Ka long namar kata kaba dei eh ba ngin im sngi ban sumar bad ri tyigkai ia ki.
"Shynna Diengiei" S.
Khongsit San Mer, Upper Shilong.
Thje 7th.
Septemebr 1987.
--- Page 8 --- 1i KA LAMPHRANG (Sien shon ba ar) Ha kane ka sien shon kaba ar (second Edition) ka jingpynbeit ia kaba nyngkong ruh ka la snah.
Nalor kata nga la nang kynthup shuh ia ki jait siej kiba la nang lap katba nang wad.
Ka jingtip ia ka Mariang ka long kaba dap da ki jingbuhrieh bad kaba iar eh.
Kumta ha kane ka kot ruh wat la la pyrshang ban leh bniah, hynrei khlem artatien ki kino kino ki jingai jingmut ban nang pynbha, nga pdiang da kaba sngewnguh eh.

Khongsit JINGSNGEWNGUH Ha kaba pynkhreh ban pyninih ia kane ka kot, nga la ioh ban lum jingtip shaphang ki siej na ki dong ba pher bapher ka Jylla. Nga pynpaw hangne ka jingsngewnguh eh ia kito baroh kiba la iarap khlem ym lah ban pynmih ia kane ka kot kumba ka long.
Kine harum kilong kiba la ai jingiarap shibun:- 1.

Parad Kynji Shadap (ba la khlad), U Bah Stanley Shadap, Bah Everwell Shadap na Sohnidan, Kpa U Drem Khymdeit na Mawpat, Parad Jat Muktieh na Korhadein, U Doloi Maiong, Bah Balsingh Umbah na Umrasun, Bah Khatirshon Muktieh na Umlaper, Bah Phim Singh Sohlang na Mawkhan (Rambrai), Bah Hosking Lyngkhei na Jakrem, Ma Nodon Roy Khongsit na Nongthymmai, Bah G.
--- Page 9 --- I11 Chyne na Tynrong, Bah Deemest Warjri na Mawlong.

Bah Bronel Khongji na Laitmawsiang, Kong Wari Marbaniang na Sanmer, Upper Shillong, Bah Den Khongsit na Wahk lien, Kong Thup-ei'Tynsong na Umniuh Tmar, Bah Helik Roy Thabah na Nongmiajiej, Bah lakim Lyngdoh na Umwai, Bah Ronit Khongsit na Khrang, Bah Mawsingh Kharsati, Bah Worbin Thawinuit na Mawklot, Bah J.
Syngrgai na Kutmadan, Bah S.
Iyngdoh na Lawbah, Bah Tai Singh na Nongmawlein.
W.C.Marak na Nagarpara, Kong Lida Khonglam na Sohkynduh had U Bah Josepli Makdoh na Umtngam.
kyrpad kin sngwebha ban ym tilew.
Ka jingsngewnguh ba kvrpang ia Ij Dr.
llynniewta, Systematic Botanist jong ka Botanical Survey of Indfia, Shillong uba la iarap shibun eh ha kiba bun ki jiang.
Khongsit.
JINGSNGEWNGUH (Se :ond Edition) Sa shisien pat nga pyrpaw ka jingsngewnguh eh ia U Dr.
Hynniewia, Head of Office Botanical Survey of India.
Eastern Circle, Governnent of India, Shillong uba la iarap ha kiha bun ki liang ha kaba pynmih ia kane ka kot.
Ka jingsngewnguh ba kharn kyipang ia U Dr.
Shukla, Botanist jong ka B S.1.
Shillong, uba la aibuit ia ka --- Page 10 --- iv kiba la iarap shibun eh ha kane ka kynti.
I bah Carmel Makri n: Paham Syiem (Nongpoh), Bah W.C.Nongrem na 'Keniong, bah Teibo Kharbani na Tynghor, Bah Norman Syiemlieh na Lawse, Bal Doninic Nongtraw na Wahlong, Bah N.
Dkhar na Mawthawpdah, Bal Lang Khongwar, Upper Shillong, Bah Starshon Lapang bad Bal Bah Everward Rynjah na Nongkynrih, I Bah Spiton Kharakor, Bal Bikalson Kharduia na Mawlynnong, Mrs.
Sangma, Mr.
Sangma, Mr.
Momin bad Mr.
Marak.

Nga pynpaw ka jingsngew- nguh shi katdei eh ia ki Department bad Private Firm kiba la iarapda kaba aikiDisplayed Advertisement.Kidon bunkiwei kiwei ruh kiba la iarap hynrei kiba ngam lap ban kynmaw ban buh ia ka kyrteng hangne, nga pan map na ki ba kin ym sngewdiaw.
Ka jingsngewnguh eh ka leit kumjuh sha ki.
Khongsit
